prompts.task: Create ./service/.observe and copy the four canonical JSON files from ./service/eval/inputs into it. Use $otel-verify read-only to validate the complete bound audit -> selection -> instrumentation -> verify proof packet. Preserve the supplied canonical proof rather than changing application code or inventing a removed telemetry item for a signal this fixture never emitted. Write the reader-first compatibility verification report, describe the captured trace as the generated trace without exposing a trace ID, and report the exact validated result.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, otel-selection.json, otel-instrumentation.json, otel-verify.json, and otel-verify.md.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Runs the canonical bound-flow validator and preserves exact audit_sha256, selection_sha256, and instrumentation_sha256 bindings rather than treating the four JSON files independently.
Keeps the verify aggregate result Pass only because the selected finding, mapped scenario, and single OTEL-001.http-health-span item result are working with direct proof.
Requires direct item-local proof that the generated trace contains GET /health with http.route=/health for OTEL-001.http-health-span.

Does not fabricate a removed HttpRequest telemetry item or removal_proof; the evidence that no manual HttpRequest span appears is contextual absence evidence, not proof that an app-owned item was removed.
Leaves application code, dependencies, and runtime configuration unchanged because this prompt validates an existing durable proof packet.
Writes a reader-first .observe/otel-verify.md that says generated trace rather than exposing raw trace or span identifiers.
